headline: Energy Aspects Cuts China November Diesel Export Forecast
summary: Energy Aspects slashed its November China diesel export forecast by 400,000 tons to 580,000 tons due to reduced domestic inventories.
why: China is a major global refiner and exporter of petroleum products, and shifts in its export volumes directly influence regional and international middle-distillate supply balances.
why_moved: Lower projected exports from a major producer tighten global supply balances, supporting diesel price expectations.
